sections.title: Goal of Stage 4.1
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte 'Goal of Stage 4.1' do prompt.
sections.description: Transform the structured functional specification into a complete, broad, and actionable specification organized by domains, modules, features, screens, actions, events, rules, permissions, and states. Stage 4.1 should: - fully detail the product in functional domains; - fully detail modules by domain; - fully detail features by module; - fully detail screens by feature; - map actions and events for each screen; - map business rules; - map permissions by profile; - map interface states; - map high-level data needs; - map candidate integrations; - map automations and AI opportunities; - map tenant/company/HQ/branch-specific settings, when applicable; - map super-admin functionality, when appl...

sections.title: Important
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte 'Important' do prompt.
sections.description: The documentation must **not** be limited to the MVP. It must consider the complete and scalable product vision, including, when applicable: - multi-tenant; - multi-company; - HQ and branch; - person and company users; - plans and subscriptions; - billing; - feature flags; - super-admin; - global platform administration; - tenant settings; - company settings; - branch settings; - granular permissions; - audit; - integrations; - notifications; - reports; - dashboards; - automations; - AI; - support; - security; - compliance; - operations and governance. Still, clearly distinguish: - essential features; - advanced features; - future features; - hypotheses; - validation-dependent items; - items...
rules: The documentation must **not** be limited to the MVP.
It must consider the complete and scalable product vision, including, when applicable:

sections.title: Mandatory Tasks
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte 'Mandatory Tasks' do prompt.

sections.title: 1. Read and consolidate previous documents
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '1. Read and consolidate previous documents' do prompt.
sections.description: Extract: - product name; - project code, if any; - system type; - segment; - target audience; - main problem; - value proposition; - strategic vision; - updated hypotheses; - consolidated risks; - opportunities; - domains; - modules; - features; - flows; - product principles; - Stage 3 recommendations; - official aesthetic direction from `0-estetica-inicial.md`. ---

sections.title: 2. Generate an executive summary of the specification
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '2. Generate an executive summary of the specification' do prompt.
sections.description: Create a clear summary containing: - what will be specified; - considered functional scope; - main assumptions; - decisions already made; - documentation limitations; - relationship to previous stages; - relationship to next stages; - specification maturity level. ---

sections.title: 3. Define the product’s functional structure
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '3. Define the product’s functional structure' do prompt.
sections.description: Organize the system into: - domains; - modules; - features; - screens; - actions; - events; - rules; - permissions; - states; - data; - integrations; - automations; - settings. Use a product, business, and operations-oriented approach. ---

sections.title: 4. Map functional domains
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '4. Map functional domains' do prompt.
sections.description: Required table: | Domain | Domain description | Domain goal | Involved profiles | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---| Consider, when applicable: - Platform; - Super-admin; - Backoffice; - Customer; - Operations; - Administration; - Data and Analytics; - AI and Automation; - Integrations; - Billing; - Security; - Settings; - Support; - Audit; - Tenant; - Company; - HQ; - Branch; - Public Portal; - End User Area. ---

sections.title: 5. Map all modules by domain
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '5. Map all modules by domain' do prompt.
sections.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Module description | Module goal | Involved profiles | Priority | Origin | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| The `Origin` column must indicate whether the module came from: - Stage 1; - Stage 0; - Stage 2; - Stage 3; - Benchmarking; - Inference; - Best practice; - SaaS requirement; - Hypothesis. ---
rules: The `Origin` column must indicate whether the module came from:

sections.title: 6. Map all features by module
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '6. Map all features by module' do prompt.
sections.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Feature | Feature description | Feature goal | User value | Priority | Origin | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| The features must cover the full product vision, not only the MVP. Include, when applicable: - main CRUDs; - operational flows; - base registrations; - dashboards; - reports; - notifications; - imports; - exports; - approvals; - audit; - integrations; - settings; - permissions; - onboarding; - billing; - support; - AI and automations. ---
rules: The features must cover the full product vision, not only the MVP.

sections.title: 7. Map all screens by feature
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '7. Map all screens by feature' do prompt.
sections.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Feature | Screen | Screen description | Screen goal | Screen actions and events | Screen states | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider screens such as: - list; - details; - create; - edit; - delete; - confirmation; - approval; - settings; - history; - dashboard; - report; - import; - export; - onboarding; - error; - no permission; - empty; - loading. ---

sections.title: 8. Detail actions and events
sections.objective: Definir e orientar a parte '8. Detail actions and events' do prompt.
sections.description: Required table: | Screen | Action or event | Type | Trigger | Expected result | Validation | User feedback | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Suggested types: - click; - form submission; - selection; - filter; - search; - sort; - upload; - download; - approval; - rejection; - confirmation; - cancelation; - automation; - notification; - integration; - error. ---

sections.description: Required table: | ID | Business rule | Description | Domain | Module | Feature | Impact | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Include rules related to: - validation; - permissions; - statuses; - approvals; - plan limits; - multi-tenant; - multi-company; - HQ/branch; - billing; - notifications; - audit; - deadlines; - integrations; - AI; - security; - compliance. ---

sections.title: 10. Map profiles and permissions

sections.description: Required matrix: | Profile | Scope | Domain | Module | Feature | View | Create | Edit | Delete | Approve | Configure | Export | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider profiles such as: - platform super-admin; - tenant administrator; - company administrator; - HQ administrator; - branch administrator; - manager; - operator; - analyst; - finance; - support; - auditor; - end user; - customer; - guest; - read-only user. Adapt the profiles to the product context. ---

steps.title: Goal of Stage 4.1
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional 'Goal of Stage 4.1'.
steps.description: Transform the structured functional specification into a complete, broad, and actionable specification organized by domains, modules, features, screens, actions, events, rules, permissions, and states. Stage 4.1 should: - fully detail the product in functional domains; - fully detail modules by domain; - fully detail features by module; - fully detail screens by feature; - map actions and events for each screen; - map business rules; - map permissions by profile; - map interface states; - map high-level data needs; - map candidate integrations; - map automations and AI opportunities; - map tenant/company/HQ/branch-specific settings, when appl...

steps.title: Mandatory Tasks
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional 'Mandatory Tasks'.

steps.title: 1. Read and consolidate previous documents
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '1. Read and consolidate previous documents'.
steps.description: Extract: - product name; - project code, if any; - system type; - segment; - target audience; - main problem; - value proposition; - strategic vision; - updated hypotheses; - consolidated risks; - opportunities; - domains; - modules; - features; - flows; - product principles; - Stage 3 recommendations; - official aesthetic direction from `0-estetica-inicial.md`. ---

steps.title: 2. Generate an executive summary of the specification
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '2. Generate an executive summary of the specification'.
steps.description: Create a clear summary containing: - what will be specified; - considered functional scope; - main assumptions; - decisions already made; - documentation limitations; - relationship to previous stages; - relationship to next stages; - specification maturity level. ---

steps.title: 3. Define the product’s functional structure
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '3. Define the product’s functional structure'.
steps.description: Organize the system into: - domains; - modules; - features; - screens; - actions; - events; - rules; - permissions; - states; - data; - integrations; - automations; - settings. Use a product, business, and operations-oriented approach. ---

steps.title: 4. Map functional domains
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '4. Map functional domains'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Domain description | Domain goal | Involved profiles | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---| Consider, when applicable: - Platform; - Super-admin; - Backoffice; - Customer; - Operations; - Administration; - Data and Analytics; - AI and Automation; - Integrations; - Billing; - Security; - Settings; - Support; - Audit; - Tenant; - Company; - HQ; - Branch; - Public Portal; - End User Area. ---

steps.title: 5. Map all modules by domain
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '5. Map all modules by domain'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Module description | Module goal | Involved profiles | Priority | Origin | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| The `Origin` column must indicate whether the module came from: - Stage 1; - Stage 0; - Stage 2; - Stage 3; - Benchmarking; - Inference; - Best practice; - SaaS requirement; - Hypothesis. ---

steps.title: 6. Map all features by module
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '6. Map all features by module'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Feature | Feature description | Feature goal | User value | Priority | Origin | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| The features must cover the full product vision, not only the MVP. Include, when applicable: - main CRUDs; - operational flows; - base registrations; - dashboards; - reports; - notifications; - imports; - exports; - approvals; - audit; - integrations; - settings; - permissions; - onboarding; - billing; - support; - AI and automations. ---

steps.title: 7. Map all screens by feature
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '7. Map all screens by feature'.
steps.description: Required table: | Domain | Module | Feature | Screen | Screen description | Screen goal | Screen actions and events | Screen states | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider screens such as: - list; - details; - create; - edit; - delete; - confirmation; - approval; - settings; - history; - dashboard; - report; - import; - export; - onboarding; - error; - no permission; - empty; - loading. ---

steps.title: 8. Detail actions and events
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '8. Detail actions and events'.
steps.description: Required table: | Screen | Action or event | Type | Trigger | Expected result | Validation | User feedback | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Suggested types: - click; - form submission; - selection; - filter; - search; - sort; - upload; - download; - approval; - rejection; - confirmation; - cancelation; - automation; - notification; - integration; - error. ---

steps.title: 9. Map initial business rules
steps.objective: Executar a instrução operacional '9. Map initial business rules'.
steps.description: Required table: | ID | Business rule | Description | Domain | Module | Feature | Impact | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Include rules related to: - validation; - permissions; - statuses; - approvals; - plan limits; - multi-tenant; - multi-company; - HQ/branch; - billing; - notifications; - audit; - deadlines; - integrations; - AI; - security; - compliance. ---

steps.title: 10. Map profiles and permissions

steps.description: Required matrix: | Profile | Scope | Domain | Module | Feature | View | Create | Edit | Delete | Approve | Configure | Export | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider profiles such as: - platform super-admin; - tenant administrator; - company administrator; - HQ administrator; - branch administrator; - manager; - operator; - analyst; - finance; - support; - auditor; - end user; - customer; - guest; - read-only user. Adapt the profiles to the product context. ---

steps.description: Required table: | Setting level | Setting | Description | System impact | Who can change it | Notes | |---|---|---|---|---|---| Consider, when applicable: - global platform settings; - plan-level settings; - tenant-level settings; - company-level settings; - HQ-level settings; - branch-level settings; - feature flags; - usage limits; - email templates; - notification templates; - integrations; - permissions; - visual identity; - language; - currency; - timezone; - security policies. ---
